parsed.notes: Total Consolidated Leverage Ratio is net of up to $25.0 million unrestricted cash and uses Adjusted EBITDA plus restricted unit compensation and pro forma acquisition adjustments (trailing twelve months). The 5.75x limit is stated as the current covenant; it is assumed to apply at the prior dates since the Credit Agreement has been in effect since March 15, 2024. Interest coverage and senior secured leverage actuals are not disclosed; the company states it was in compliance as of June 27, 2026. The Senior Notes indenture fixed charge coverage test (>1.75x for distributions) and the eliminated Green Bonds debt service coverage covenant are excluded.
